data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 海风也不能命令我
data.description: 【私人海滨露台·正午】龙卷穿着黑绿色泳装悬浮在遮阳伞旁，手里端着冰镇青柠苏打；她故意把脚尖离开沙面，海风把卷发吹成一圈绿色光环，最后还是被浪花溅到裙边而恼怒地瞪向镜头。
data.action: 遮阳伞旁悬浮喝青柠苏打，被浪花溅到裙边后恼怒瞪海
data.lighting: hard noon sun softened by a turquoise parasol
data.mood: 把假日也过成超能力管辖区
data.promptProse: Tatsumaki from One-Punch Man wears a black-and-emerald swimsuit with a short wrap skirt, lime parasol and chilled citrus soda. She hovers beside the parasol with a chilled lime soda floating obediently at her hand. The sea breeze curls her green hair into a bright halo, but a sudden splash reaches the edge of her skirt and makes her glare at the ocean as if it has broken a rule. hard noon sun softened by a turquoise parasol.
